signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check --fix writes each Diataxis folder's README.md from its pages: a marker comment saying kmctl writes it, then one entry per page with its H1 title as link text and its description front matter when present; it changes no other file, and a second run changes nothing.
signed_rows.fails_when: a page is missing or extra, an entry lacks the title or the description a page has, the marker is missing, --fix changes the root index, .okf/ or any other file, or a second run changes a file

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check fails (exit 1) with exactly one error when a folder has no README.md or its index differs from what kmctl would generate, and the fix names kmctl check --fix.
signed_rows.fails_when: check exits 0, reports other than one error for either case, or the fix does not name kmctl check --fix

signed_rows.behavior: When docs/README.md has no link to a folder index, kmctl check reports one finding at the new warning level and exits 0, and the CI action's summary shows the warning and the action passes.
signed_rows.fails_when: check exits nonzero, reports it as an error or not at all, or the action fails or omits the warning
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_docs_frontmatter.py tests/test_action.py -k root_missing_folder_link -q

signed_rows.behavior: A folder README.md without kmctl's marker is never overwritten by kmctl check --fix, kmctl new doc or kmctl update, and kmctl check warns (exit 0) that kmctl does not manage it.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of the three changes the hand-written file, or check errors or says nothing

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl new doc writes description (from --description), stale_after three months ahead and an empty sources, never verified, and regenerates its folder index; kmctl update writes each missing folder index and leaves an existing docs/README.md unchanged.
signed_rows.fails_when: a field is missing or wrong, verified is written, the folder index lacks the new page, or update changes docs/README.md or skips a missing folder index
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_docs_frontmatter.py tests/test_new_doc.py tests/test_init.py -k "new_doc_front_matter or update_folder_indexes" -q

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl review due lists a docs page whose stale_after has passed or whose listed source changed, with an id starting docs/ and the same --json shape; a docs page with no verified, or with no front matter, is not listed for that.
signed_rows.fails_when: a stale or source-changed docs page is missing, its id lacks the docs/ prefix, the --json shape changes, or a page is due only for a missing verified

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check reports an error for a docs page whose description, stale_after, verified or sources has the wrong shape, naming the page and the field; a page with no front matter passes.
signed_rows.fails_when: a malformed field passes, the finding omits the page or field, or a page with no front matter fails

signed_rows.behavior: This repo's docs/ is migrated: four generated folder indexes, docs/README.md links each folder, every page carries a description, and kmctl check on the repo passes with no warnings; docs/ holds no okf_version, log.md or type field.
signed_rows.fails_when: check reports an error or warning on the repo, a page lacks a description, or docs/ carries an OKF bundle marker

signed_rows.behavior: A new decision records docs front matter, generated indexes and the pre-commit hook and amends ADR 0006; the manifesto's I4 names the docs fields and its kmctl description names kmctl check --fix; this repo's .claude/rules/docs-layout.md, docs/reference/commands.md (check --fix and the warning level) and the briefing line match.
signed_rows.fails_when: the decision is missing or does not amend ADR 0006, or any of those pages still describes the flat index or omits the front matter or check --fix

signed_rows.behavior: .pre-commit-hooks.yaml offers hook kmctl-check, which runs kmctl check without passing file names; in a scratch repo that lists this checkout under repos:, pre-commit run kmctl-check fails on a missing folder index, and with args: [--fix] it writes the index, and a second run passes.
signed_rows.fails_when: the hook id is missing, it passes file names, it passes with a missing folder index, or --fix does not write it
no hook in the config runs kmctl check

signed_rows.behavior: The agent instructions kmctl ships say docs pages may carry description, stale_after, verified and sources, that folder indexes are generated, and to run kmctl check --fix rather than edit one: the docs-layout rule and its Antigravity copy, the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md block kmctl init writes, the write-docs skill, the auditor agent and the audit skill.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of them still says to edit an index by hand, describes only the flat docs/README.md index, or omits the front matter or kmctl check --fix

signed_rows.behavior: The decision and the changed pages say in plain language why docs/ borrows OKF fields without becoming a bundle, and why folder indexes are generated while the root index stays hand-written.
signed_rows.fails_when: the reasoning is missing, contradicts the plan, or reads as jargon

resigns.reason: Operator added kmctl check --fix (replacing kmctl docs index), a kmctl-check pre-commit hook, and updates to the agent instructions kmctl ships
